ApplicabilityMapping.description: Where a statement holds, when supported by source evidence. Dimensions are open-ended.

columns.description: Map a dimension named by the source to an authorized column. No particular dimension is required.
columns.title: Columns

values.description: Explicitly declared constant applicability dimensions; these are not observed source values.
values.title: Values

ApplicabilityMapping.title: ApplicabilityMapping

ColumnEndpoint.description: A fixed column object attached only to observed rows of its own table.

evidence_refs.description: Issued metadata or applicable document references supporting this column meaning; never raw values or invented evidence IDs.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

ColumnEndpoint.title: ColumnEndpoint

EndpointLookup.description: Resolve one endpoint through actual equal-key matches in an authorized table.

predicate.description: Typed Predicate/1.0 filter: is_not_null/is_null have no value, ne uses value; logical all/any/not (and alias). Read reference:predicate-guide.md. No raw SQL.
predicate.title: Predicate

match_columns.description: Columns matched to the corresponding relation key_columns, in order. Include tenant or other required matching scope explicitly.
match_columns.title: Match Columns

key_columns.description: Columns from the matched row that form the resolved entity identity.
key_columns.title: Key Columns

cardinality.description: one rejects matches to multiple distinct endpoint identities; many explicitly permits all observed matches for this input row.
cardinality.title: Cardinality

on_missing.description: error diagnoses unmatched references; omit explicitly omits unmatched input rows and reports their count.
on_missing.title: On Missing

EndpointLookup.title: EndpointLookup

identity_scope.description: Whether the complete key identifies an object throughout its identifier system or only within declared dimensions. A global key requires a documented identity domain and evidence.
identity_scope.title: Identity Scope

identity_domain.description: Documented identifier system or shared identity authority. A matching label alone does not establish a shared identifier.
identity_domain.title: Identity Domain

identity_evidence_refs.description: Issued evidence supporting the declared identity domain and grain; global identity requires at least one reference.
identity_evidence_refs.title: Identity Evidence Refs

identity_context_keys.description: For scoped identities, the subset of key_names within which the rest of the key is unique. Include these parts in mapping keys and relation endpoint keys.
identity_context_keys.title: Identity Context Keys

display_mode.description: For objects without a source label: derive from visible relations or the complete identity. Explicit source labels always take precedence.
display_mode.title: Display Mode

predicate.description: Typed Predicate/1.0 filter: is_not_null/is_null have no value, ne uses value; logical all/any/not (and alias). Read reference:predicate-guide.md. No raw SQL.
predicate.title: Predicate

properties.description: Business property name -> physical column carrying the value in this table. Omit a property when this table does not provide it; another mapping may supply it.
properties.title: Properties

constant_properties.description: Agent-declared mapping annotations, distinct from source values. Source table, key columns, and endpoint columns are already recorded in provenance.
constant_properties.title: Constant Properties

identity_qualifiers.description: Entity property name -> documented identity qualifier (e.g. measurement unit). Contradictory observed values block reviewed merges.
identity_qualifiers.title: Identity Qualifiers

hierarchy_position_roles.description: Constant property -> endpoint whose physical hierarchy position the constant encodes. Use node on entities.
hierarchy_position_roles.title: Hierarchy Position Roles

context_columns.description: Authorized columns that identify a source-row context shared across mappings. Retained on each support, never added to entity identity. Use the same column set for related mappings.
context_columns.title: Context Columns

applicability.description: Optional applicability of this observation. Omit when no scope is documented; omitted scope is unknown. Row provenance and read permissions have separate fields.

label_column.description: Physical column containing the primary source name (e.g. Chinese name). Choose a confirmed name column when available; omission generates a display/identity fallback and does not check name consistency. Never omit a known name to bypass a conflict.
label_column.title: Label Column

english_name_column.description: Physical column containing a confirmed English name for this object. Leave null if absent; never guess from aliases.
english_name_column.title: English Name Column

description_column.description: Physical column containing row-level object description text. Distinct from database catalog comments.
description_column.title: Description Column

alias_columns.description: Confirmed alternate names, translations or abbreviations for the same object. Display columns alone do not become aliases.
alias_columns.title: Alias Columns

display_columns.description: Supplementary display components, or a composite display for objects without an independent name. Does not replace label_column or alias_columns and never changes identity.
display_columns.title: Display Columns

MetadataColumnMapping.description: One authorized catalog column as a physical semantic object, not its values.

evidence_refs.description: Issued metadata or applicable document references supporting this column meaning; never raw values or invented evidence IDs.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

label.description: Agent-declared primary meaning supported by evidence. If omitted, catalog comment then physical column name is used; no fact values are read.
label.title: Label

semantic_annotations.description: Evidence-backed Agent interpretations; recorded as declared annotations, separately from observed catalog metadata.
semantic_annotations.title: Semantic Annotations

MetadataColumnMapping.title: MetadataColumnMapping

hierarchy_orientation.description: Direction of a documented parent/child relationship relative to source_type and target_type. Use none for ordinary associations. Directedness or acyclicity alone does not establish a hierarchy.
hierarchy_orientation.title: Hierarchy Orientation

predicate.description: Typed Predicate/1.0 filter: is_not_null/is_null have no value, ne uses value; logical all/any/not (and alias). Read reference:predicate-guide.md. No raw SQL.
predicate.title: Predicate

properties.description: Business property name -> physical column carrying the value in this table. Omit a property when this table does not provide it; another mapping may supply it.
properties.title: Properties

constant_properties.description: Agent-declared mapping annotations, distinct from source values. Source table, key columns, and endpoint columns are already recorded in provenance.
constant_properties.title: Constant Properties

identity_qualifiers.description: Entity property name -> documented identity qualifier (e.g. measurement unit). Contradictory observed values block reviewed merges.
identity_qualifiers.title: Identity Qualifiers

hierarchy_position_roles.description: Constant property -> endpoint whose physical hierarchy position the constant encodes. Use node on entities.
hierarchy_position_roles.title: Hierarchy Position Roles

context_columns.description: Authorized columns that identify a source-row context shared across mappings. Retained on each support, never added to entity identity. Use the same column set for related mappings.
context_columns.title: Context Columns

applicability.description: Optional applicability of this observation. Omit when no scope is documented; omitted scope is unknown. Row provenance and read permissions have separate fields.

metadata_basis.description: Required for a column endpoint. schema_applies_to_rows declares applicability to actual selected rows using evidence; observed_non_null restricts rows by that physical column IS NOT NULL without retaining its values. NULL absence never proves non-applicability.
metadata_basis.title: Metadata Basis

extends_base_graph.description: Whether this incremental draft references entity types inherited from a frozen base graph.
extends_base_graph.title: Extends Base Graph

inherited_entity_types.description: Explicitly reused frozen types. They can be relation endpoints or receive new property mappings under their existing identity contract. See inherited_graph_summary.entity_contracts.
inherited_entity_types.title: Inherited Entity Types

inherited_entity_key_arities.description: Optional expected identity key arity per inherited entity type.
inherited_entity_key_arities.title: Inherited Entity Key Arities

unresolved.description: Only unmet requirements of the current user goal. Empty when covered; never invent missing work.
unresolved.title: Unresolved

decisions.description: Evidence-backed choices already applied; these do not prevent completion.
decisions.title: Decisions

suggestions.description: Optional future improvements outside the current goal; these do not prevent completion.
suggestions.title: Suggestions
